summary: Mint Incorporation Limited furnished a Form 6-K on October 7, 2026, disclosing that Axonex Robotics Limited, its majority-owned subsidiary, entered an OEM Supply and License Agreement with Ireland-based Centridex Limited. The two-year program runs October 1, 2026 to September 30, 2028, with total potential value of approximately EUR 3 million and an initial order package worth roughly EUR 450,000 covering robot kits and platform licensing. Mint will supply kits and license software; Centridex assembles and resells finished robots in Ireland. This is an ordinary commercial supply and licensing contract, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
